notes.title: Update 1.5.3
Update 1.5.3
Host your match and Dedicated servers
notes.notes:
The last update has brought some performance improvements, however if you are having ping issues connecting to the current available dedicated servers please keep in mind that you can host your match without any problem.

If you host your match your friends and everyone will be able to join, you can choose the map, the frag limit and the time limit you want and also the gamemode. Doing this you will have no lag because you will be the host, obviously the ping is based on the server/host location. 

Hosting your match is really simple, just get into the main menu, Host your match, set everything up and press on the map you want, the game will start when at least one other player will connect.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/107356734871544454/EBCAF5FA1AC133EFB8C677A26E3B59B31FEB20BC/[/img]

That said i'm constantly working on improving the servers, hoping to provide players with an enjoyable game experience.

Happy Holidays.

- Reaper
